name: Signal
description: The GearBook mark builds itself: a sage peak and an amber peak rise out of a flat ridge line, the wordmark settles under them and the ridge carries one slow pulse out to the edge. Opens or closes any reel.
covers: Brand sting only. Carries no data and no words beyond the wordmark.

name: Transitions
description: Three cuts that work on real trip footage. Ridge Cut wipes along a mountain profile, Clip In snaps the next clip through a carabiner gate, Whip runs the colour bars across while the footage itself whips.
covers: Clip to clip transitions. No text, no data.

name: Catalog Score
description: A member's catalog completeness as a dial: rings fill for name, bio, photo, payout and each product, and the score rolls in at the centre. Board and Orbit looks for longer explainers.
covers: One member, one score, one moment in time. Not a change over time.

name: Coin Pile
description: Coins stack up under a caption. Retired: it read as a money promise, which GearBook copy never makes.
covers: Retired.

name: Your Catalog
description: Hundreds of drifting dots stream home into the shape of a member's catalog grid, one dot per product view, and the card sets: name, sport, "Shop my gear".
covers: A member's catalog as a whole. Not a single product.

name: Sports
description: One opener per sport (climbing, ski and snow, mountain, water). Each sport owns a line shape generated from its name, so it's the same line every time it appears.
covers: Section openers by sport. No numbers.

name: Statement Cards
description: One short line slams in, word by word, on a flat ground, with the key word in amber brackets. For the line the reel hangs on.
covers: Words only. One statement per card.

name: Name Cards
description: Lower third for whoever is on camera: name, role, and a hairline that draws under them. Sits clear of Instagram's button rail.
covers: Who is talking. Name and role only.

name: One Number
description: A single big number rolls up like an odometer with one line of context under it. For a total or a count.
covers: One aggregate number. Not a member's change over time, and not a comparison.

name: How it works
description: Four steps on a trail line: pick your gear, we build the tracked link, share your catalog, get paid monthly. Each step lights as it's said.
covers: GearBook's four-step explainer. Fixed steps.

name: Then & Now
description: Two values morph from one to the other with a then and now label. For any single before and after.
covers: Exactly two values. Nothing in between.

name: Series Openers
description: The partner showcase opener: the partner's logo lands on the GearBook ridge and the episode title types in. Reused for every partner reel.
covers: Opens a series episode. One partner per episode.

name: Pop-outs
description: Product cutouts fly in over footage with a label tag: the pack, the rope, the dive computer. From the presenter bit.
covers: Showing products. Up to four at once.

name: Loops
description: Seamless topo-line loops for behind text or under a voiceover. Never draws attention.
covers: Background texture only.

name: End Cards
description: The brand colour bars run across, the wordmark lands, "Click the link in our bio". Every reel ends here.
covers: Sign-off only.

name: Crying Map
description: A map with a crying emoji for "landlocked in Colorado". Retired: a one-off meme, now done in the edit with a sticker.
covers: Retired.

name: Quiet
description: Footage softens out of focus and one small line fades in. For the pause before the payoff.
covers: A beat of silence with one line. No data.

name: Click Trail
description: One member's clicks across N months as a trail that climbs: each month lands as a point, the line draws between them and the last point lights amber. One engine, three looks: Switchback (dotted climb on bark), Ledger (bar rows on the explainer's cream and topo) and Summit (big number on sage).
covers: One member's number changing over several months.

name: Spread Map
description: A US map where a member's clicks land as small sage pins state by state, then the count of states rolls in.
covers: Where shoppers are, by state.

name: Load Shift
description: A pack's weight split into bars (shelter, sleep, kitchen, water) that shift as gear is swapped, the total ticking down.
covers: Parts of one whole changing. Gear weights, time split.

name: Then vs Now Tally
description: Two bars, old time and new time, fill on the words and the shorter one wins. For any before and after of time or effort.
covers: Time or effort, before and after, as two bars.

name: Relay Line
description: Steps of a process sit on one trail line; an amber marker walks it and each stop lights when it's named. Labels change per video, for any how-we-work clip.
covers: A process of 3 to 5 named steps, with custom labels.

name: Highlight Sweep
description: A sage block runs behind words as they're said, on a card over footage. Marker, Underline run and Lift out looks.
covers: Emphasising a phrase on screen.

name: Path Trace
description: Traces a climber's real move frame by frame: ghost frames, a dotted path, and a tick on the hold that lands it.
covers: Showing a movement path over footage.

name: Signup Explainer
description: The 28 second signup reel Matt had Claude build as a Motion artifact ("GearBook Signup Reel" on his Claude account). It plays here live from the artifact's own scene code: client questions pop up, a phone applies, adds gear with one search, shares the catalog after a trip and with a friend, then gear drops into a pack and the pack becomes the logo. Its cream and topo ground, serif titles that arrive word by word and small tracked labels are the house style every new piece follows.
covers: The whole member journey, apply to share to earn, as one 28 s reel. Not a single stat or step on its own.

name: Ping
description: A GearBook notification drops in over footage on a ding, holds long enough to read and slides away. Banner is a realistic phone notification with glass over a blur of the footage; House and Island are on-brand alternatives.
covers: One notification over footage: an app line, a title and up to two lines of body.

name: Site Screen
description: Someone using gearbook.shop, from real screenshots: the cursor clicks Shop the gear, the climbing page scrolls to a product, it gets an amber ring and a tag. Pop-out grows the browser out of a laptop in the footage; Laptop and Full screen stand alone.
covers: One short browse on the site ending on one product. New pages need new screenshots (scripts/capture-site.mjs).

name: Pro Dashboard
description: A pro's GearBook dashboard on a phone, drawn from the real member dashboard at phone width, popping forward over footage like M27's pop-out (transparent, for the presenter bit in the suit). Build taps into the Trad Climbing catalog (Skiing and Layers beside it, real products with photos), stars a Top Pick and adds a Camalot C4 from search; Tour walks Catalog, Clicks and Marketing; Zoom pops the stat tiles out of the phone and counts them up.
covers: The member dashboard on a phone: catalogs, products, clicks and sales counts, the marketing kit. No dollar figures by default. Sample member and numbers; the Marketing tab is still a placeholder on the live site.
